test_cached_dataset: test the CachedDataset class by creating a dataset from an iterable and verifying element access
create_cached_dataset_from_iterable: create a CachedDataset from an iterable of python objects serialized to an h5py file
test_cached_dataset_len: test the CachedDataset __len__ method returns the correct number of stored elements
test_cached_dataset_getitem: test the CachedDataset __getitem__ method retrieves stored python objects by index
test_cached_dataset_iteration: test the CachedDataset __iter__ method yields stored elements in order
